title: Data Science Team Lead
description:
Data Science Team Lead

London | £100,000

This is a rare opportunity to lead a growing Data Science function at a business where AI, Machine Learning, and advanced analytics are central to long-term strategy. You'll combine team leadership with hands-on technical delivery, driving solutions that deliver measurable impact across a complex, data-rich environment.

The Company

They are a globally recognised organisation investing heavily in Data, AI, and digital transformation. With a strong focus on innovation, they are leveraging machine learning, natural language processing, and generative AI to enhance decision-making, improve operational efficiency, and develop market-leading solutions. The business offers a highly collaborative environment where Data Science plays a visible and strategic role.

The Role

  • Lead and mentor a team of Data Scientists while setting technical standards and best practices.
  • Deliver machine learning, deep learning, NLP, forecasting, optimisation, and GenAI solutions that solve real business challenges.
  • Act as the technical lead for AI initiatives, working closely with senior stakeholders, technology teams, and business leaders.
  • Remain hands-on with model development, deployment, and the adoption of emerging AI technologies including LLM and RAG applications.

Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong commercial experience leading Data Science teams and delivering machine learning solutions into production.
  • Advanced Python expertise and experience with tools such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Scikit-Learn.
  • Experience working with NLP, unstructured data, deep learning, and modern AI techniques.
  • Exposure to Generative AI, LLMs, RAG architectures, or related AI applications.
  • Proven ability to influence stakeholders and translate business requirements into scalable data solutions.
  • Experience mentoring and developing technical teams within a collaborative environment.

How to Apply

If you're looking for a Data Science leadership role where you can shape AI strategy, lead high-performing teams, and deliver cutting-edge machine learning solutions, apply today to find out more.
